title: Who checks the recommendation?
hook: Does a better recommendation help when nobody checks it?

doesNotKnow: In 1,000 cases, reviewers correct every error they check and add none. A has a 10% error rate and 80% review rate; B has a 4% error rate and 10% review rate. Which combined system leaves fewer errors?

objective: Compute the declared automation bias model and distinguish its countercase.
